S1.title: sunglasses push-in -> through the lens into jungle
S1.prompt: Cinematic luxury sunglasses commercial, one continuous take. A pair of glossy black acetate wayfarer sunglasses with slim silver oval pins on the front corners rests on a pale textured limestone ledge. Warm late-afternoon sun casts crisp horizontal venetian-blind shadows across the cream wall and the stone. The lenses are deep black and mirror a sunlit tropical jungle. Camera: a slow deliberate dolly push-in on the right lens, then the push accelerates and the camera glides straight through the glass into the reflected jungle — palm fronds whip past, sunlight flares, green bokeh, heavy speed blur. Shot on 35mm anamorphic, shallow depth of field, fine natural grain, photoreal product detail, no text, no logo. Audio: soft breeze and distant birds, a rising airy whoosh as the camera enters the lens, no music, no voices.
